entries.title: See what each automation run found
entries.body: An automation's history now shows what your first mate found on each run, beside when it ran and what it led to, so you can check a reminder or a recurring check run by run. When you ask to hear about something another service announces, such as a workflow run finishing on GitHub, your first mate now waits for that event instead of checking on a clock.

picture.alt: An automation's History in Settings with two handled runs, each with a Found line saying what the first mate found
